description: On desktop, Studio's own main window may call keep_awake_set, which Settings › Remote's "Keep this computer awake while it's plugged in" switch and the remote state call (phase 2 G5, HAL-17641). It takes only two switches, the setting and remote; the shell holds the system's sleep lock only while both are on and the computer is on mains power. A focused app's window gets none of it, and it is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets nothing.
